            setSource(sources[0]);
        }

        const hitGemius = (id) => {
            if (!_var_is_consent_ok) {
                return;
            }
            setTimeout(() => {
            let { pp_gemius_identifier: gemius_ident } = window || {};

            if (gemius_ident && typeof gemius_hit === "function") {
                gemius_hit(gemius_ident.replace(/^used\_/i, ""));
            }
            }, 100);

            new Image(1, 1).src = `/api/counter?id=${id}`;
        };

        Array.prototype.move = function (from, to) {
            this.splice(to, 0, this.splice(from, 1)[0]);
        };

        const generateTooltip = (element, text) => {
            const tooltipSpan = document.createElement("span");

            tooltipSpan.className = "theo-button-tooltip vjs-hidden";
            tooltipSpan.innerText = text;

            const toggleTooltip = () => {
            tooltipSpan.classList.toggle("vjs-hidden");
            };

            element.addEventListener("mouseover", toggleTooltip);
            element.addEventListener("mouseout", toggleTooltip);
            element.appendChild(tooltipSpan);
        };

        const extendedControls = (player) => {
            // setting up the custom icon by setting up a video-js component
            const Button = THEOplayer.videojs.getComponent("Button");

            const SkipBackward = THEOplayer.videojs.extend(Button, {
                constructor: function () {
                    Button.apply(this, arguments); // required

                    generateTooltip(this.el(), "Skip backward");
                },
                handleClick: function () {
                    handleSkipBackward();
                },
                buildCSSClass: function () {
                    if (player.source.sources.length <= 1) {
                    return "hidden";
                    }

                    return "tp-icon tp-icon__backward vjs-control vjs-button";
                },
            });

            const SkipForward = THEOplayer.videojs.extend(Button, {
                constructor: function () {
                    Button.apply(this, arguments); // required

                    generateTooltip(this.el(), "Skip forward");
                },
                handleClick: function () {
                    handleSkipForward();
                },
                buildCSSClass: function () {
                    if (player.source.sources.length <= 1) {
                    return "hidden";
                    }

                    return "tp-icon tp-icon__forward vjs-control vjs-button";
                },
            });

            const SeekForward = THEOplayer.videojs.extend(Button, {
                constructor: function () {
                    Button.apply(this, arguments); // required

                    generateTooltip(this.el(), "Seek forward");
                },
                handleClick: function () {
                    player.currentTime += 15;
                },
                buildCSSClass: function () {
                    return "d-none d-md-block tp-icon tp-icon__seek-forward vjs-control vjs-button ";
                },
            });

            const SeekBackward = THEOplayer.videojs.extend(Button, {
                constructor: function () {
                    Button.apply(this, arguments); // required

                    generateTooltip(this.el(), "Seek backward");
                },
                handleClick: function () {
                    player.currentTime -= 15;
                },
                buildCSSClass: function () {
                    return "d-none d-md-block tp-icon tp-icon__seek-backward vjs-control vjs-button";
                },
            });

            const FullScreen = THEOplayer.videojs.extend(Button, {
                constructor: function () {
                    Button.apply(this, arguments); // required

                    generateTooltip(this.el(), "Fullscreen");
                },
                handleClick: function () {
                    const video = activeInstance.element.querySelector('video');


                    if (video && video.webkitEnterFullScreen) {
                        // Toggle fullscreen in Safari for iPad
                        video.webkitEnterFullScreen();
                    } else {
                        activeInstance.presentationMode = 
                            activeInstance.presentationMode === 'fullscreen' ? 'inline' : 'fullscreen';
                    }
                },
                buildCSSClass: function () {
                    return "tp-icon tp-icon__fullscreen vjs-control vjs-button";
                },
            });

            THEOplayer.videojs.registerComponent("SkipBackward", SkipBackward);
            THEOplayer.videojs.registerComponent("SkipForward", SkipForward);
            THEOplayer.videojs.registerComponent("SeekBackward", SeekBackward);
            THEOplayer.videojs.registerComponent("SeekForward", SeekForward);
            THEOplayer.videojs.registerComponent("FullScreen", FullScreen);

            player.ui.getChild("controlBar").addChild("skipBackward", {});
            player.ui.getChild("controlBar").addChild("skipForward", {});
            player.ui.getChild("controlBar").addChild("seekBackward", {});
            player.ui.getChild("controlBar").addChild("seekForward", {});
            player.ui.getChild("controlBar").addChild("fullScreen", {});
        };

        const getSource = async (url) => {
            const baseUrl = "/servisai/stream_url/vod/media_info/?url=";
            const results = await fetch(`${baseUrl}${url}`).then((response) =>
            response.json()
            );

            return results;
        };

        const onSwipe = (element, callback) => {
            let touchstartX = 0
            let touchendX = 0
                
            const handleDirection = (event) => {
                if (touchendX < touchstartX - 100) {
                    callback('left', event);
                }
                if (touchendX > touchstartX + 100) {
                    callback('right', event);
                }
            }

            element.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                touchstartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX
            });

            element.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
                touchendX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX
                handleDirection(e);
            });

            return () => {
                element.removeEventListener('touchstart', e => {
                    touchstartX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX
                });

                element.removeEventListener('touchend', e => {
                    touchendX = e.changedTouches[0].screenX
                    handleDirection(e);
                });
            }
        }

        const setupPlayer = async (parent, anchor) => {
            const element = parent.querySelector(".theoplayer-container");
            const options = getTHEOOptions();

            swipeCallbacks = onSwipe(parent, (direction) => {
                if (direction === 'left') {
                    console.log('next');
                    handleSkipForward();
                }
                if (direction === 'right') {
                    console.log('prev');
                    handleSkipBackward();
                }
            });

            // Get current index of source
            const url = anchor.getAttribute("data-video-url");
            const currentIndex = sources.findIndex((item) => item.url === url);

            // Allign source to be in order
            const startSlice = sources.slice(currentIndex, sources.length);
            const endSlice = sources.slice(0, currentIndex);

            source = [...startSlice, ...endSlice];

            activeInstance = new THEOplayer.Player(element, {
                libraryLocation: options.libraryLocation,
                license: options.license,
                mutedAutoplay: "all",
            });

            await setSource(source[0]);

            activeInstance.addEventListener("ended", () => {
                handleSkipForward();
            });
        };

        jQuery(".short-video__modal").on("shown.bs.modal", async function (e) {
            await setupPlayer(e.currentTarget, e.relatedTarget);

            jQuery(".modal-backdrop").addClass("dark");
            jQuery("body").addClass("short-video__body");

            if (activeInstance) {
                extendedControls(activeInstance);
                hitGemius(activeInstance.source.sources[0].id);

                activeInstance.play();
            }
        });

        jQuery(".short-video__modal").on("hide.bs.modal", function (e) {
            jQuery("body").removeClass("short-video__body");

            if (activeInstance) {
                activeInstance.destroy();
            }

            if (swipeCallbacks) {
                swipeCallbacks();
            }
        });

        const appHeight = () => document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--app-height', `${window.innerHeight}px`)
        window.addEventListener('resize', appHeight)
        appHeight();
    };
</script>

         data["render-tmpl"] = '2-4-4-4';
			jQuery.ajax({
				  url: '/api/category/get',
				  data: data,

                     if (data.rendered_articles) {
                        var $last_el_number = $target_div.children().length;
                        $target_div.append(data.rendered_articles);
                        $target_div.children().eq($last_el_number).find('h2').find('a').first().focus();

                        window.myConfig.lazyLoadInstance.update();
                     }
                     if (!data.articles_total || (data.articles_total > 0 && data.articles_total < _load_items)) {
                        $(el).hide();
                     }   
                  }

                     $(el).hide();
                  }
				  }

		}
	}
